evidence: The <title> element Required Every HTML document must have exactly one non-empty <title> element inside <head>.
The <meta charset> Required Declare UTF-8 as the document character encoding in the first 1024 bytes of the HTML, so browsers parse text correctly before they hit any non-ASCII content.
The <meta viewport> Required Tell mobile browsers to render the page at the device's actual width instead of pretending to be a 980-pixel desktop.
